name: io.github.walidboulanouar/ai-automation-agencies
title: AI Automation Agencies
description: Shortlist automation agencies by workflow and source-linked case studies.

tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: Find AI automation agencies by name, specialty or workflow. Omit the query for the full directory. Results include IDs for compare_firms and links to sources.

tools.name: compare_firms
tools.description: Compare two to five AI automation agencies by their directory IDs from search_firms. Returns profiles, source links and procurement questions.

tools.name: recommend_providers
tools.description: Read the editorial picks for AI automation agencies, each with a specific use case and supporting source. Use short project keywords, or omit the query to review all picks.
